domains.title: Modeling and Topology
domains.description: Polygon mesh structure, quad-dominant subdivision edge flow, pole placement, manifold geometry, face orientation, and unit-scale transform hygiene.

domains.title: Hard-Surface and Organic Workflows
domains.description: Non-destructive modifier stacks, boolean/bevel/weighted-normal shading control, CAD/panel detailing, and organic sculpt-to-retopology projection.

domains.title: Geometry Nodes and Procedural Generation
domains.description: Fields evaluation, anonymous and named attributes, point distribution, procedural instancing, and Realize Instances memory/export boundaries.

domains.title: UV Mapping, Texturing, and Baking
domains.description: UV seam placement, texel density consistency, single-atlas vs. UDIM packing, mipmap bleed margins, and tangent-space MikkTSpace normal/AO baking.

domains.title: Materials, Shaders, and PBR
domains.description: Energy-conserving Principled BSDF v2 parameters, linear vs. sRGB color-space assignment, ORM channel packing, and shader-to-glTF export portability.

domains.title: Lighting, Cameras, Composition, and Rendering
domains.description: Three-point and HDRI studio lighting ratios, physical camera optics and depth of field, AgX/Filmic view transforms, and Cycles vs. EEVEE rendering.

domains.title: Rigging and Animation
domains.description: Armature joint hierarchies, 4-influence linear blend skinning normalization, NLA action baking, visual keying, and morph target (shape key) export.

domains.title: Simulation and VFX
domains.description: Rigid body and cloth simulation caching, collision proxy selection, volumetric fog/mist tradeoffs, and baking physics to deterministic keyframes/caches.

domains.title: Environment and Architectural Scene Assembly
domains.description: Real-world metric scale conventions, modular architectural grid snapping, pivot placement, and foreground/midground/background depth layering.

domains.title: Optimization, LOD, and Performance
domains.description: Device-tier triangle, draw-call, and VRAM budgets, discrete LOD hierarchy generation, and KTX2/Draco/Meshopt compression tradeoffs.

domains.title: Interchange, glTF/GLB, and Web Delivery
domains.description: Khronos glTF 2.0 / GLB binary chunk specifications, coordinate system conversions (+Z up to +Y up), and Three.js / React Three Fiber visual parity.

versionBaseline.upcoming_unreleased_note: Blender 5.3 is scheduled for release on November 10, 2026 and is not treated as a stable production baseline yet.
